title: Horizon entropy does not by itself determine a force between black holes
summary: The Bekenstein-Hawking law fixes the total entropy of a horizon. Membrane, holographic, and entropic-force pictures go further and follow the entropy of individual horizon elements as a configuration changes. We show that this step needs structure that the horizon geometry does not supply. Along a family of horizons labeled by $λ$, a relabeling of horizon points by a tangential field $v^A$ shifts the temperature-weighted entropy variation $\int T\partial_λ(dS)$ exactly by $-\int v^AD_AT dS$, so the horizon data determine it only when the temperature is uniform.
